investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-02T00:59Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway at the AWS ELB endpoint (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents). Because the failure is upstream of agent creation, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected and all contract assertions remain unverifiable. This is an eval-detected infrastructure connectivity failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning endpoint — was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. Every remote-agents check calls POST /api/agents as its first step (evidenced by run-status-probes.mjs line 1885: createAgent(args, track, "remote", null, orgId)), and all three checks received the same 502 bad_gateway response with the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning". Because the gateway was unreachable before any agent was created, no VM was provisioned and no evidence fields could be populated, causing total contract failure. The exact cause of the ELB being unreachable (misconfiguration, health-check failure, network ACL change, or transient outage) is not determinable from the supplied evidence alone.
